title: Lost in Instructions: Study of Blind Users’ Experiences with DIY Manuals and AI-Rewritten Instructions for Assembly, Operation, and Troubleshooting of Tangible Products

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating AI-generated DIY instructions through a usability study and interviews with blind participants, specifically measuring 'vision-default bias' by analyzing the frequency with which AI tools rely on inaccessible visual referents (e.g., colors, visual labels, and diagrams) instead of providing necessary tactile, spatial, and orientational cues.
